'''Grea''', also known as '''Grea the Orfite''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Orfite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. She used her highly developed sense of smell to track people. She owned a custom built [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Neverquit]]''.

==Biography==
Grea was born on [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]], the Orfite [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. She left her home [[Planet/Legends|planet]] as soon as she could. She later won a small ship from a gambler and picked up her military skills while ferrying a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] around the [[Methall'has sector/Legends|Methall'has sector]].<ref name="PoG3" />
